name: ROQANG-rvt
title: RVT series surface-mount aluminium electrolytic capacitors, 6.3 V to 450 V, 105 °C 2000 h
summary: The RVT series are chip-type aluminium electrolytic capacitors on a plastic seat plate, in cans from Ø4 mm to Ø18 mm. Rated voltages run from 6.3 V to 450 V and capacitances from 1 µF upward, at ±20 % tolerance. Each part is rated for 2000 hours at 105 °C under rated voltage; the lowest operating temperature is -55 °C, -40 °C or -20 °C depending on the voltage. The series is RoHS compliant and is made for dense surface-mount boards.

operation.text: An order code is the series name RVT, then a two-character voltage code, a three-character capacitance code (two digits and a multiplier, R marking the decimal point), a tolerance letter and a four-digit size code giving diameter and height. The worked example is RVT, 0J, 471, M, 0810: 470 µF, 6.3 V, ±20 %, Ø8×10 mm. The example's voltage code OJ should read 0J.

The can top carries the capacitance in µF, the rated voltage and the series name RVT, with a dark negative mark on the negative side. The marking layout differs between cans of Ø6.3 and below, Ø8 to Ø10, and Ø12.5 and above.

Permissible ripple figures are at 120 Hz and 105 °C. At other frequencies the figure is multiplied by the frequency coefficient: 0.80 at 50 Hz, 1.25 at 1 kHz and 1.40 at 10KS, or 0.85, 1.15 and 1.25 for capacitances from above 1,000 µF to 8,200 µF.

Infrared or hot-air reflow is used; vapour-phase reflow is not recommended. One reflow pass is recommended; if a second is needed, at least 60 minutes must pass between the two. For lead-free reflow, preheat from 150 °C to 180 °C lasts no more than 120 s, and the time above 217 °C, the time above 230 °C, the peak temperature and the time near peak each stay within the limits for the case size.
Production is certified to ISO9001:2015, ISO14001:2015 and IATF 16949:2016, and the series is designed to meet AEC-Q200.
Parts ship on a reel with a 13±0.5 mm arbor hole, a hub of Ø50 mm minimum, flange thickness 2 mm, and the inner width A and outer diameter D given per case size in the packing table.
